decisions.note: Candidate locator 101201211 matches JP 怒濤のポロロッカ; preserve Pororoca as the proper name of the tidal-bore phenomenon instead of translating the zh-CN name semantically.
Candidate locator 105801111 matches JP 怒涛のスピード; Tốc độ vũ bão is concise and preserves the forceful 怒涛 image.
JP is 怒涛のラッキー大猛進！, but the deliberately exaggerated mixed wording admits several Vietnamese rhythms; no repository convention establishes one canonical title yet.
JP is 怒涛の超幸運パワー！; the stylized combination of 怒涛, 超幸運 and パワー has multiple plausible Vietnamese treatments, so defer rather than force one.
Candidate locator 201211 matches JP 怒涛の追い上げ; the Vietnamese title preserves both the late push and the forceful 怒涛 image naturally.
Candidate locator 203232 matches JP 逸る足取り; háo hức captures the eager/impetuous nuance of 逸る better than a generic speed calque.
Candidate locator 204541 is verified in the pinned source, but a reliable exact JP title has not been established for this item; do not lock from the zh-CN bridge alone.
Candidate locator 202322 matches JP 急浮上; Vọt lên is a compact natural Vietnamese title for the sudden rise.

Candidate locator 204272 matches JP 急旋回; Rẽ gấp is short, natural and mechanically clear.
Candidate locator 203322 matches JP 駆け降り; the Vietnamese title conveys actively running/rushing downhill rather than merely descending.
Candidate locator 203041 matches JP トキメキハート; the Vietnamese title naturally preserves both the fluttering-heart feeling and the explicit heart image.
The JP skill title is 怪物; Quái vật is the direct, stable Vietnamese equivalent.
Candidate locator 100601211 matches JP 怪物的コーナリング; the Vietnamese title keeps the monster image and expresses cornering naturally.
Candidate locator 202942 maps to JP 鬼気迫って, but the idiomatic intensity of 鬼気迫って has several Vietnamese possibilities; no stable canonical title is established yet.
